# GraphCraft changelog

User-facing release notes. Install: `pip install MertCapkin_GraphCraft[graphstack]`

---

## v2.4.0 — Clean install & documentation (2026-06-21)

**Polish release** — better first-run experience, no dev cycle noise in templates.

### Clean handoff & generated files
- Fresh `graphcraft init` ships **empty board** (`todo/` / `doing/` / `done/`) — no completed cycle JSON
- Handoff templates: `BRIEF.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `STATE.json`, `DESIGN_STATE.json` (idle defaults)
- `research/INSPIRATION.template.md` — generate `INSPIRATION.md` via CLI (not bundled filled)
- `graphcraft-out/.gitkeep` only — reports/graphs generated by `design update` / `evaluate`
- `.gitignore` patterns for generated outputs and board task files

### Documentation
- README rewritten: quick start, aesthetic/originality, **Stitch** (pull / MCP / manual), UI stacks, layout
- Installer copies full handoff template set on first install

---

## v2.3.0 — Originality engine (2026-06-21)

- `graphcraft aesthetic research distill` — anti-slop filter, differentiation thesis
- `originality` score in `design evaluate` (token, layout, reference, signature, distill)
- Design audit blocks on originality FAIL

---

## v2.2.0 — Aesthetic web research automation (2026-06-21)

- `graphcraft aesthetic research run` — DuckDuckGo search → `INSPIRATION.md`
- `graphcraft aesthetic research doctor` — network + config preflight

---

## v2.1.0 — Stitch pull via official SDK (2026-06-21)

- `graphcraft stitch pull` — `@google/stitch-sdk` via `npx`
- `graphcraft stitch doctor` — auth + MCP readiness
- Env: `STITCH_API_KEY` or OAuth vars

---

## v2.0.0 — Design intelligence milestone (2026-06-21)

Bundles v0.2–v0.7 feature work into one major release:

| Area | Highlights |
|------|------------|
| Design graph | bridge, unified query, `design path/explain` |
| Aesthetic | evaluate rubric, style packs (`minimal-dark`, `warm-light`) |
| Stitch / visual | MCP helper, fetch, visual review |
| UI lib | RN, Flutter, Unity, Godot — ButtonPrimary, LoginScreen |
| Cycle / gate | `graphcraft cycle`, `graphcraft gate`, `DESIGN_STATE.json` |

---

## v0.1.1 — PyPI & overlay model (2026-06-21)

- GraphCraft-only PyPI wheel; GraphStack via `[graphstack]` extra
- Overlay orchestrator (`graphcraft.mdc`, `docs/FLOW.md`)

---

## v0.1.0 — Foundation (2026-06-21)

- `graphcraft` CLI on GraphStack
- Design graph, style packs, Cursor skills, Stitch import scaffold

## Upgrade path

| From | To | Notes |
|------|-----|-------|
| 0.1.x | 2.4+ | Re-run `graphcraft install .`; new CLI commands available |
| 2.0–2.3 | 2.4 | No breaking CLI changes; cleaner init templates |
